ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer Compatibility (Bodge Jobs)
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Multiplayer Team; fork by Zapdude
ModMetaData.description:
1.7 fork of Multiplayer Compatibility, maintained in the Multiplayer Bodge Jobs repository. Built from the MIT-licensed project at https://github.com/rwmt/Multiplayer-Compatibility; the 1.7 module code was recovered from the temporary 1.7 build (workshop 3820003665). See NOTICE.md for provenance and PATCHES.md for the changes this fork carries.
Requires Multiplayer Bodged, the 1.7 fork of Multiplayer.
Adds sync for the customization commit of Persona Weapons Unbound and Unique Weapons Unbound.
